description: Ground-truth per-ply execution trace for uci_to_fen_easy_6. Each step gives the board state (FEN) before and after one half-move. Use steps[k].fen_after as the verified expected output for any pipeline sub-block ending at ply k+1 (1-indexed); steps[k].fen_before is the verified input FEN for the sub-block starting at ply k+1.
